names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 3 aprilie, «Sfântul Mucenic Elpidifor».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Ελπιδηφόρος», with the rank word left off. The life page gives «Ελπιδοφόρος» as a second spelling of the same name.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 3 aprilie — «Sfântul Mucenic Elpidifor»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Ελπιδηφόρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole account of him is one clause, «Ο Άγιος Ελπιδηφόρος (ή Ελπιδοφόρος) μαρτύρησε δια ξίφους» — he was martyred by the sword — with the second spelling of the name given beside the first. No year, no place, no emperor, no relics, no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
